outcome: Availability of human resources, equipment, medicines, and supplies for MNH care
Knowledge and practice of high-impact MNH interventions
cohort: Pregnant women and newborns receiving care at a sample of private hospitals in Iraq
finding: While private hospitals in Iraq generally had the resources necessary for quality MNH care, there were gaps in knowledge and practice of high-impact interventions like skin-to-skin care and breastfeeding support.
mod_finding: Most births (88%) documented were cesarean births.
